key_concepts: Merge CHOP outputs the channels from all connected CHOP inputs.
Channel order follows the order of the input CHOPs.
The Duplicate Names menu determines whether conflicting channel names are made unique, kept from the first input, kept from the last input, or replaced.
The Align menu resolves inputs with different start and end intervals by extending, stretching, shifting, or trimming channels.
With Time Slice enabled, Merge CHOP merges the current time slice rather than the full historical channel range.
Sample Rate Match controls whether mixed sample rates are resampled or treated as an error.
common_gotchas: Duplicate names are common after merges; choose the duplicate-name policy before exporting or binding the resulting channels.
Align modes can trim, stretch, shift, or extend data, so verify the output interval before using merged channels as timing references.
Time-sliced merges output only the current slice, not the entire input length.
Mixed sample rates can be resampled unless Sample Rate Match is set to error on rate mismatch.
